consequence.statement: An exposed environment whose operator does nothing is unaffected: the removed-values list is empty, so no previously accepted spec.chartRef.kind value is rejected; the previously invalid value ExternalArtifact simply becomes accepted.

assertion.statement: In the helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2 HelmRelease schema, the enum of spec.chartRef.kind gained the allowed value ExternalArtifact (computed artifact diff between the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install bundles), with no values removed.
